preconditions.description: Attacker must be the admin of the TransparentUpgradeableProxy contract

exploit_hint: As the admin of the TransparentUpgradeableProxy, call upgradeTo() or upgradeToAndCall() with a malicious implementation contract address. The malicious contract can then execute arbitrary code through delegatecall, potentially stealing funds or manipulating contract state. The attack requires admin privileges which may have been obtained through social engineering, compromised keys, or improper access control in the admin management system.
